relations.reading: Component-level compliance does not establish ecosystem-level integrity when independently governed actors compose their decisions under changing conditions.

relations.title: Función federada de integridad
relations.reading: A shared integrity label becomes useful only when the mission states which cross-domain conditions affect trustworthy operation and who owns them.

relations.title: Autoridad de decisión
relations.reading: The mission contract can make requalification explicit when changed evidence or operating conditions alter the boundary of accountable action.

relations.title: Función federada de integridad
relations.reading: Mission-level operational integrity and an enterprise integrity function operate at different scopes and should connect through explicit responsibilities rather than be collapsed into one role.

relations.title: Admisibilidad contextual
relations.reading: Transformation integrity requires revisiting the assumptions behind the integrity boundary when the intervention changes the operating regime itself.

relations.title: Fallo de composición
relations.reading: The case raises a composition question: locally plausible actions can still require a system-level check of relationships, authority and changed context.

relations.title: Control mínimo suficiente
relations.reading: MSCA could provide a later review structure for a bounded airport intervention: the protected outcome, justified control burden and authorized response must be explicit.
